jobs.description: Job description: Emirates Cabin Crew are responsible for delivering the Fly Better onboard experience to passengers across our global network. As a member of our Cabin Crew team, you will be the onboard representative of our brand, delivering our signature award-winning service while maintaining world-class safety standards. In the role, you will ensure the safety and comfort of our passengers, manage onboard service and maintain cabin cleanliness throughout each flight. You will respond to passenger requests, working collaboratively with your fellow colleagues to ensure a smooth flight. You will also uphold the highest of service standards in line with the Emirates Fly Better promise. Candidate profile: To be considered for Emirates Cabin Crew, you’ll need to be: Fluent in written and spoken English (additional languages are an advantage) A natural team player with a personality that shines At least 160cm tall and able to reach 212cm high Able to meet the UAE’s employment visa requirements At least 21 years old And have: At least 1 year of hospitality or customer service experience A minimum of high school (Grade 12) education No visible tattoos while in Emirates Cabin Crew uniform Salary information: Your salary includes a fixed basic pay and variable flying pay, which is calculated using number of hours you fly during the month. Salaries are paid monthly. What the company offers: Emirates offers career progression opportunities as you grow in knowledge, skills and confidence. From providing the best customer experience in Economy Class to leading the whole team as purser, we always strive to provide our staff with development pathways that matches your personal and professional ambitions. All Emirates Cabin Crew enjoy a wealth of personal benefits. Furnished accommodation is provided free of charge, with utilities being paid for by the company. When you’re on duty, you’ll enjoy free company transport between your accommodation and the airport/training college,

Do you enjoy working with your hands, developing technical skills, and earning a great salary right from the start? As an Industrial Cleaner in IJmuiden, you play a crucial role in ensuring the safety of others. No diploma or technical background is required: we teach you everything on the job! Both English- and Dutch-speaking candidates are warmly welcome.

In this active entry-level role, you are responsible for maintaining, disassembling, assembling, and thoroughly cleaning life-saving safety equipment, such as breathing apparatuses and gas detection devices.

What will you be doing?

- Collect safety equipment from clients and carefully disassemble devices following clear step-by-step instructions
- Thoroughly clean, inspect, and reassemble all components with precision
- Calibrate and certify devices to ensure they are 100% safe and ready for use
- Accurately register all completed tasks in the system
- Enjoy variety in your work: depending on scheduling, you may occasionally drive as a chauffeur between different work sites to pick up or deliver equipment

You will work 32 to 40 hours per week in a fixed, structured 2-shift rotation (06:00 – 14:00 and 14:00 – 22:00). Due to the early and late shift hours, the industrial site in IJmuiden is best reached using your own transportation (car or motorcycle).

- No diploma or specific experience required (full training provided on the job)
- Valid driver's license B (and preferably your own transport, such as a car or motorcycle)
- Good command of English or Dutch
- Physically fit (able to lift up to 18 kg when needed)
- Available to work in 2 shifts (06:00 – 14:00 and 14:00 – 22:00) for 32 to 40 hours per week

In this role, you are the guardian of quality for highly specialized processes within an international high-tech company. The company develops, repairs, and inspects critical components for the aerospace, energy, and defense industries. Together with your team, you work every day to achieve the highest standards of quality and safety.

Your attention to detail and expertise in handling valuable and delicate components make you an essential partner for our customers. In addition, you participate in 5S projects aimed at making work processes safer and more efficient.

You will work in a rotating two-shift schedule: one week in the day shift (five days) and the next week in the evening shift (four days).

- Perform Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) inspections to ensure quality and detect discontinuities or defects using methods such as eddy current testing and ultrasonic testing
- Experience with: Visual inspections, dimensional inspections, receiving inspections and reading and interpreting technical drawings
- Knowledge of and experience with measuring instruments such as calipers and micrometers
- Good command of the English language

As a warehouse production worker, you are responsible for sorting, processing, and preparing IT materials for further processing or recycling. As an operator:

- You have experience as an operator or in production
- You have a good level of Dutch or English
- You live in the region of Eindhoven, Helmond, Weert, Veldhoven, Deurne or Venray

Are you passionate about sports and looking for an exciting career in logistics? Join our dynamic team at Decathlon's ultra-modern warehouse in Tilburg! We're seeking enthusiastic individuals to help manage our international distribution center, serving stores and customers across multiple European countries.

Your role in our team
As a Logistics Employee at Decathlon, you'll be part of a dedicated team responsible for ensuring smooth operations in our state-of-the-art facility. Your main duties will include:

- Processing orders efficiently using advanced robotic systems

- Collaborating with team members to meet daily goals and targets

- Maintaining high standards of accuracy and safety in all operational processes

- Opportunity to develop into specialized roles such as 'captain' or 'trainer'

What we offer
At Decathlon, we value our employees and offer a range of benefits to support your growth and well-being:

- Competitive starting salary of €2338.27 per month (38-hour week), with potential for monthly bonuses

- 8% holiday pay and 24 vacation days

- 20% discount on Decathlon products

- Comprehensive training and development opportunities

- Employee share ownership program

- Travel expense reimbursement (100% for bike/public transport, 50% for car up to 30km)

- Access to sports coaching and wellness platforms

- Regular team events and outings

What we're looking for
The ideal candidate for this role will possess:

- A passion for sports and an active lifestyle

- Flexibility to work 32-38 hours per week, including one weekend day

- Availability for various shifts (morning, afternoon/evening, night)

- Excellent command of English

- Valid Dutch passport/visa/work permit

- Residence within a 30-minute radius of our Tilburg warehouse

- Alignment with our core values: vitality, generosity, responsibility, and authenticity

About Decathlon
Decathlon is a global leader in sporting goods retail, committed to making sports accessible to all.
